'''Traffic Interdiction Operations''', or '''TIOPS''', were missions to detain and board ships suspected of enemy activity. One such operation was [[Omega Squad]]'s [[Mission to the Corellian-Perlemian Intersection|TIOPS mission]] to capture a ship and its crew that was suspected of involvement in terrorist attacks on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. [[Traffic Interdiction Vessel]]s were often used for these missions.
